findings.title: Establish capacity for both entities before the two-entity controls invoke the unchecked constructor
findings.evidence: The single initial free-index check proves only one free entity exists. Cases7 and8 then construct a and b without any second-slot capacity check. If exactly one slot remains, a consumes it and b construction returns NULL from the underlying create routine; the helper immediately passes it to sample initialization, which asserts/dereferences it. Later safe snapshot/update predicates cannot protect this earlier call. These cases advertise explicit prerequisite refusal, so one available slot cannot be treated as sufficient for two.
findings.required_change: Check the actual two-entity prerequisite before invoking the unchecked second constructor and refuse safely if insufficient. Restore descriptor/delta/tracking state before any error/refusal, and state any partial entity creation honestly. Preserve ordinary constructor/allocation behavior; no fake sample lifetime or new heap framework is needed.

findings.title: Apply complete per-call and cross-capture coherence to the new data-case reports
findings.evidence: The new branch independently reimplements a weaker journal validator: it checks routine ownership, total ENTER/KILL counts and only the final unfinished point, but no intervening transition or upd state machine. For case5, deleting the first CLIENT_EXIT while reducing stored still leaves three ENTERs, a final CLIENT_EXIT and the same calls/end state, so the missing middle operation is accepted. Arbitrary upd values are never checked; report.kills is not reconciled with summed kills; declared delta-row calls, end skipped and per-case entity/count inputs are not bound to the observed calls/stopping conditions. Independent env-sound-state rows are not joined to adjacent probe captures: its own positive case4 has creation-state life_w=40a00000 while the same constructor CREATED probe record remains generic life_w=3fc00000. No game write occurs between these two captures, so accepting that contradiction is not an alternative lifetime outcome. Typed descriptor rows likewise do not establish that the named controlled inputs were used.
findings.required_change: Reuse the established per-entity transition/update-pair rules for this at-most-three-call unsampled domain. Reconcile per-case declared inputs/entities/planned calls/skipped counts with actual state/probe calls, permitting skips only after a dead or unlinked state; bind report kill totals, current update ordinals and stable cohort identity. Match creation snapshots to CREATED fields and client post-call snapshots to corresponding EXIT fields where they are the same capture point, without calculating an expected lifetime. Correct canned positives so the independent captures agree, and add finite coherent damaged-record guards for these named cases. Keep all physical outputs observed and do not introduce a preferred numerical oracle.
